# anecdotes_saml_configuration (Resource)

Manages a SAML 2.0 identity provider configuration (Settings > Login Methods > SAML 2.0).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# display_name must be unique per tenant: provider_id is derived from it, so a
# duplicate display_name is rejected as a conflict rather than creating a second
# configuration.
resource "anecdotes_saml_configuration" "okta" {
  display_name  = "OktaSSO"
  idp_entity_id = "http://www.okta.com/exampleIDPEntityID"
  rp_entity_id  = "https://gateway.anecdotes.ai/saml/metadata"
  sso_url       = "https://example.okta.com/app/exampleapp/sso/saml"

  x509_certificates = [
    file("${path.module}/okta-cert.pem"),
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) A display name for the configuration.
- `idp_entity_id` (String) The identity provider's entity ID.
- `rp_entity_id` (String) The relying party (this platform's) entity ID.
- `sso_url` (String) The identity provider's SSO URL.
- `x509_certificates` (List of String) One or more PEM-encoded signing certificates.

### Read-Only

- `idp_type` (String) Server-assigned, e.g. `okta`, `azuread`, or `custom`.
- `provider_id` (String) The configuration's identifier, server-generated from `display_name` at creation. Stable across updates, including a `display_name` change.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a SAML configuration by its provider_id.
terraform import anecdotes_saml_configuration.example saml.a0000000000
```
